articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Expanded Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5 in mid-August 2026, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a larger effective context window exceeding 500k tokens. Benchmarks show step-change improvements in graduate-level science and multi-step code generation tasks, though independent evaluators note diminishing returns on certain narrow NLP benchmarks compared to the GPT-4o to GPT-5 leap.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 model demonstrated the ability to autonomously complete complex multi-file software engineering tasks on SWE-Bench Verified with a solve rate above 75%, a substantial jump from prior models. The system integrates tool use, web browsing, and sandboxed code execution in an agentic loop, raising questions about the near-term impact on professional software development workflows.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Pilot Deployment at Gigafactory Texas
articles.summary: Tesla began deploying approximately 200 Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots in materials handling and quality inspection roles at its Austin Gigafactory. The new generation features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation, though Tesla acknowledged the robots still require human supervisory oversight for edge cases.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Partnership to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the expansion of its partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across multiple stages of vehicle assembly at BMW's Spartanburg plant. The robots leverage foundation models fine-tuned on manufacturing data to perform insertion, fastening, and visual inspection tasks, marking one of the largest commercial humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing to date.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise framework enabling companies to define domain-specific constitutional rules that govern autonomous AI agent behavior in production systems. The framework provides auditable trace logs, hierarchical permission scoping, and real-time constraint enforcement, addressing a growing demand from regulated industries deploying agentic AI systems at scale.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around transistor architecture has entered volume production at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, roughly one quarter ahead of the originally announced timeline. The node delivers an estimated 20% power efficiency improvement over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from major customers by early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trial in Paralysis Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical trial to up to 50 participants with severe paralysis, following positive 18-month safety and efficacy data from its initial cohort. Participants demonstrated sustained high-bandwidth cursor and robotic arm control, with the latest N2 implant featuring 4,096 electrodes and improved wireless data throughput.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the weights for Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and roughly 200 billion active parameters per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on most academic benchmarks while running efficiently on commodity multi-GPU setups, intensifying the debate over the competitive dynamics between open-weight and closed-source AI development.
